'''Hangar Bay 3-18A''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking facility]] on the [[Derilyn Space Defense Platform]]. The [[Space station/Legends|station's]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] were stored in the hangar bay.
